project_info.name: Triumphs of Talent × Grand Food Fest Proposal
project_info.goal: Convince Triumphs of Talent to present a new award show inside Grand Food Fest. Pitch a permanent physical plaque / digital badge over a single-night award.
project_info.vibe: Premium, restrained, architectural, award-certificate, highly emotional and prestigious.

rules: CRITICAL: NO PHOTOGRAPHY OR RASTER IMAGES ALLOWED.
Every visual MUST BE an inline hand-drawn SVG illustration.
Style: Single-weight stroke (1px to 1.5px), NO fill except for occasional #c9a24b (Gold) tiny accents.
Vibe: Architectural line drawing or certificate engraving.
required_svgs: recurring_award_frame: Starts empty in Section 1. Slowly gets details across page. Fully completed in Final Section with 'Triumphs of Talent Presents'.
podium_spotlight: Spotlight cone intersecting with a podium outline.
restaurant_storefront: Line-art of a restaurant facade with a plaque clearly visible on the wall.
phone_badge: Minimalist phone outline containing a digital badge icon.

motion.philosophy: Smooth, slow, deliberate. 'Awwwards-level' kinetic typography. Nothing bouncy.

effects.hero_text: Masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion (y: '100%' to '0%').
effects.parallax: Subtle y-axis shifts on SVG illustrations during scroll.
effects.marquee: Slow editorial ribbon (react-fast-marquee) with Serif font and Gold/Ivory tones.

layout_spacing.padding: Generous. py-24 to py-32 for sections. 2-3x standard spacing.
layout_spacing.grid: Asymmetrical. Avoid center-everything. Tension through left-aligned dense text vs large right-aligned SVG art.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT use generic AI SVGs or emojis. Create high-quality custom `<svg>` paths by hand-coding coordinates to mimic architectural lines, keeping strokeWidth={1} or {1.5}.
NO PHOTOGRAPHY. Do not use the image search tool. If you use an `` tag, it can ONLY be for the provided brand logos, otherwise strict SVG code.
Strictly follow the typography scale: H1 MUST NOT exceed text-6xl. Use fluid typography scaling.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are on all interactive elements.
Use Framer Motion for the kinetic line-by-line hero reveal and scroll-triggered fade-ups.
Never center-align paragraphs. Keep long text left-aligned for editorial elegance.
Do not use generic gradients. Keep backgrounds solid #0d0d0d or #1c1a17.
Mobile MUST carry the same full text explanations as desktop, do not hide text on mobile.
